evidence.title: 日下舊聞考 法慧寺、宝相寺、谐奇趣
evidence.excerpt_zh: 海嶽開襟東北為諧竒趣東為法慧寺山門西嚮内為四面延樓後殿為光明性海其西别院有琉璃方塔法慧寺東為寳相寺山門南嚮内為澄光閣後為曇霏閣又後崇基上有殿為現大圓鏡（長春園册）臣等謹案法慧寺山門額曰普香界現大圓鏡殿内額曰香臺華鬘
evidence.summary: The only line in 日下舊聞考 on the European palaces: 諧竒趣 north-east of 海嶽開襟. Then 法慧寺 with a west-facing gate, 四面延樓, 光明性海 and a glazed square pagoda; 寳相寺 with a south-facing gate, 澄光閣, 曇霏閣 and 現大圓鏡 on a raised base.

evidence.title: 御製 上天竺法喜寺
evidence.excerpt_zh:
上天竺法喜寺
…工肖斯像二而供奉之于御園之法慧寺及玉泉山　之清涼禪窟…
evidence.summary: Poem on a Hangzhou temple, with a long note on its Guanyin. It says he had two copies of the image made, one for 法慧寺 in the imperial garden and one for 清涼禪窟 at Jade Spring Hill.

evidence.title: 法慧寺
evidence.locator: v3 p.351, under 法慧寺; source ref 1-175
evidence.excerpt_zh: 能仁度众生，演妙观察智。尽登宝莲航，斯愿诚不易。天竺瞻礼曾，慈云临福地。恩波荫大千，六种同蒙赐。杨枝早息氛，神勇消邪魅。民沐佛威光，宗门法不二。
evidence.summary: Poem 法慧寺 by the Jiaqing Emperor, 1796, filed by the editors under 法慧寺.

evidence.title: 法慧寺
evidence.locator: v3 p.352, under 法慧寺; source ref 1-388
evidence.excerpt_zh: 寺仿天竺式，普门济众生。超脱诸苦趣，境遇应感更。杨枝洒震旦，法雨苏勾萌。慈悲随汝愿，接引知群情。善慧有宿果，平等无所争。
evidence.summary: Poem 法慧寺 by the Jiaqing Emperor, 1798, filed by the editors under 法慧寺.

evidence.title: 法慧寺
evidence.locator: v3 p.352, under 法慧寺; source ref 2-248
evidence.excerpt_zh: 境仿上天竺，恩波震旦敷。杨柳试挥洒，甘露遍霑濡。法本有真谛，禅原辟野狐。慧光破愚暗，遵路弃迷途。
evidence.summary: Poem 法慧寺 by the Jiaqing Emperor, 1803, filed by the editors under 法慧寺.

evidence.title: Qing record, overview item 91
evidence.excerpt_zh: 该首领太监等均著留发当差，有年老不愿留发者，听其在原处当差，终身而止，亦不必上殿念经。
evidence.summary: 1839 order ending the use of eunuchs as monks at the garden's temples, naming 慈云普护, 舍卫城, 永日堂, 广育宫, 关帝庙, 法慧寺, 河神庙.

evidence.title: 玉明 侍游御園記 (in 蕉軒隨錄)
evidence.locator: 蕉軒隨錄, 御園侍游 (line 336 of the corpus file)
evidence.excerpt_zh: ◎御园侍游玉将军（明）有《侍游御园记》，成竹坪同年（林）曾属予代作跋语，恭书于后。按，《记》云：“咸丰六年秋七月二十一日，奉旨：本日散朝后，著玉明、肃顺自备鞍马，午初一刻进西南门，在山高水长伺候。有顷，上从内乘船，至山高水长后阁扇下船，出前门，谕玉明、肃顺暨珠勒亨、西拉布、托云、德勒格尔、伊勒东阿等脱去外褂。上乘马，命七臣随行。自山高水长游藻园，至厂地，过汇芳书院，复由紫碧山房至鱼跃鸢飞少坐。过蕊珠宫门，至黄花磴进茶毕，往西洋楼海宴堂，至转马台，过小角门，至狮子林清淑斋赏饭。左右四卓，命七臣坐，并奉温谕可饱食，非外边筵宴比也。上命膳房先给七臣面各一器，上进面，复进饭，颁赏御用菜蔬，七臣叩头谢。上进粥，复赏粥毕。随驾起行，由宝相寺、法慧寺、谐奇趣过明春门，至雷峰夕照马头，坐如在天上船，游福海。上命笔砚作诗毕，至渊氵亭镜澈马头下船。进丽春门骑马，由旧园东墙根过敷春堂，游西大堤汉城关，至含辉楼下马，命七臣散归。玉明自道光十一年由侍卫擢厕御前二十余年，仰邀优渥，得遍瞻御园盛景。欣感之余，谨作记以纪荣遇。”
evidence.summary: A rare first-hand record of a day in the garden four years before its destruction. The emperor takes seven officials by a named route from 山高水長 through 藻園, 彚芳書院, 紫碧山房 and 魚躍鳶飛, past 蕊珠宫門, on to 海宴堂 in the 西洋樓, a meal at 清淑齋 in 獅子林, 寳相寺, 法慧寺, 諧奇趣, by boat on 福海, then 敷春堂 and 含暉楼. All were standing then.

evidence.title: 长春园: glazed pagoda of 法慧寺 Fahui Si
evidence.excerpt_other: Another was a glazed tile pagoda, square below, octagonal in the middle, and round at the top.
evidence.summary: A glazed pagoda in a temple on the shore north of the round island; stood until 1900 according to the old man Lu (n.55).

evidence.title: Site status table, about 2011: scattered remains only
evidence.summary: Scenes with only scattered, incomplete building remains in the same table. 方壶胜境 is listed separately as the one with fairly complete remains not yet tidied up. 紫碧山房, 舍卫城 and 如园 have been dug since.

evidence.title: 圆明园的法慧寺
evidence.summary: 法慧寺 Fahui Si, in 长春园, on the south slope of the ridge north of 海岳开襟, gate facing west. Reads its name and halls through Buddhist texts on 五台山, and notes temple rites run by eunuchs were stopped in 1839.

evidence.title: 圆明园五朝御制诗文集注 v3, editors' note on 法慧寺
evidence.summary: Finished 1747 on the slope north of 海岳开襟. Gate 普香界 faces west; a five-bay main hall, a five-bay rear-facing tower with eleven-bay wings (the 四面延楼), a rear hall 光明性海, and in a west court the seven-tiered glazed pagoda, square below and round above, 23.55 m.

evidence.title: 法慧寺、宝相寺平面图 (图名: 宝相法慧寺)
evidence.locator: 国家图书馆善本部 样069-1号
evidence.summary: Qianlong-period presentation plan of the two temples, 859x518 mm, colour and ink; Fahui Si has three five-bay halls on its central line. No image here; the site may ask a small payment for the full record.

searched: No picture of it found in the Forty Scenes album, its 1745 woodcuts, the Bertin gouaches and the 1887 lithograph; the 20 Xiyang Lou plates; ruin photographs on Commons, at Östasiatiska museet, the Slovene Ethnographic Museum, Historical Photographs of China, the Rijksmuseum, Wellcome and in NDL's albums of about 1900; today's photographs on Commons.
